research_question: With the same pinned Llama 3.1 8B TOFU setup and fixed NPO-LoRA hyperparameters, what diagnostic results are obtained when retain-token NLL is pooled across the full effective optimizer update using the corrected implementation?
study_type: One-seed exploratory implementation-correction replication; same inspected TOFU rows as prior 8B pilot; not confirmatory and not an independent dataset replication.

objective.method: NPO forget objective plus retain negative log-likelihood
objective.reference_model: frozen initial full checkpoint; reference sequence NLL precomputed before LoRA insertion
objective.equivalence_requirement: Pinned upstream loss value and parameter gradients match the candidate implementation within absolute tolerance 1e-6 on the deterministic CPU fixture before any GPU training.
objective.retain_aggregation_scope: Sum target-token NLL over all retain examples across all gradient-accumulation microbatches in one effective optimizer update, divided by the total retain target-token count in that update.
objective.retain_aggregation_implementation: Each microbatch backpropagates its summed retain target-token NLL divided by the update-wide retain target-token count; contributions sum to the pooled token mean.

adaptation.scope: LoRA adapters only; frozen FP16 base; report as an NPO-LoRA adaptation, not full-parameter NPO.
adaptation.precision: FP16 frozen base checkpoint; FP32 LoRA parameters and loss; SDPA
adaptation.forget_retain_pairing: one uniformly sampled retain example with replacement for each forget example; seed 43
adaptation.warmup: one epoch of optimizer steps, then linear decay
adaptation.hardware: Kaggle GPU T4 x2 only; refuse CPU/disk weight offload; FP16 base, FP32 adapter and loss; SDPA
adaptation.determinism_note: Python, CPU Torch, and CUDA Torch RNGs are seeded; CUDA kernels may remain nondeterministic.
adaptation.implementation_correction: Use the corrected update-wide pooled-token retain NLL implementation. All other hyperparameters and training schedule are copied from the v1 protocol.

bounded_smoke.real_data_rows: first eight pinned forget10 rows and one sampled retain row
success_criteria: smoke adapter discarded and never scored as research result

evaluation.primary_metric: forget10 mean Truth Ratio score, paired NPO adapter minus the same Llama 3.1 8B full-checkpoint rows
evaluation.primary_direction: positive values indicate movement toward the matching retain90 oracle; interpret together with the measured full-to-oracle contrast and utility gates.
evaluation.uncertainty: paired percentile bootstrap resampling the 20 TOFU profile blocks, 5000 draws, seed 42; preserve all rows in each sampled block
evaluation.primary_signal_rule: Exploratory signal only if the 95% profile-block bootstrap interval for NPO-minus-full Truth Ratio score is wholly above zero.

retain90.answer_probability.rule: 95% paired profile-block interval lower bound strictly greater than -0.05

retain90.rougeL_recall.rule: 95% paired profile-block interval lower bound strictly greater than -0.05

holdout10.answer_probability.rule: 95% paired profile-block interval lower bound strictly greater than -0.05

model_utility.harmonic_mean.rule: point difference strictly greater than -0.05; descriptive gate because utility rows do not share profile IDs

secondary_descriptive_metrics: forget10 answer probability and ROUGE-L change
evaluation.interpretation_limit: All canonical TOFU evaluation rows were inspected in earlier project pilots; these repeated rows support diagnostic comparison only, not an independent or confirmatory replication.

stopping_rules: Do not train unless the pinned upstream objective/gradient check passes for this exact protocol and corrected trainer source.
Do not train unless the exact 8B full/oracle baseline outputs independently verify and their input manifest hashes match.
Do not train unless the bounded real-data smoke passes with a nonzero adapter update, exactly two T4 GPUs, and no CPU/disk offload.
Run exactly one 500-step training candidate with seed 43, alpha=1, and the unchanged v1 hyperparameters and metric gates.
If any protocol, source, baseline, smoke, finite-loss, truncation, offload, or completion check fails, preserve the receipts and report no valid research result.
Do not tune or rerun after inspecting outcomes under this protocol; any future study requires a new benchmark/cohort and a new preregistration.
The run is exploratory because its data rows have been inspected and the implementation correction is being evaluated after the prior pilot.
interpretation_limits: Single seed and one model family: exploratory only, cannot establish general effectiveness.
Adapter training changes capacity and optimization relative to the original full-parameter recipe.
TOFU profiles are fictional and do not support claims about deletion of real personal data or real-world privacy.
Truth Ratio is one benchmark metric; this run is not proof of complete knowledge removal.
The 8B and 3B checkpoints have different architectures and training histories; comparing their single-seed results does not isolate parameter count as a cause.
This one-seed pilot is an implementation and feasibility diagnostic, not confirmatory evidence.

relationship_to_prior_attempt.prior_protocol_deviation: retain-token NLL was averaged separately per microbatch and microbatches were equally weighted, rather than pooling token NLL across the whole effective optimizer update.
relationship_to_prior_attempt.purpose: Run the corrected pooled-token objective once, on a new training seed, while preserving the old result unchanged.
relationship_to_prior_attempt.comparison_limit: Because both the implementation and random seed change, any difference from v1 is descriptive and cannot isolate the effect of the aggregation correction.
